entries.title: Your crew travels at warp speed
entries.body: The first mate has three new fidgets that take the crew circling it through a wormhole at warp speed: a tunnel with rings pouring out from behind its eyes, a round wormhole the crew dive through, and a side view of an hourglass wormhole with the crew in a spiral line through it. Crewmates on your other computers stay in their own groups. They play on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

picture.alt: The first mate looking down a wormhole of rings and streaking stars, with its crew flying in a flat ring around it
